thread:
maria: quick pulse — brought up nova-lite-13b in int8 and int4 on a small slice. early signal: int8 = ~1.4x cost vs 7b but close parity on our GTN prompts; int4 drops quality on longform by ~6 pts (rouge-like proxy)

alex: can you paste the microbench numbers? p50/p95 and tokens/sec pls

maria: p50: 120ms (int8), 95ms (7b baseline); p95: 420ms (int8), 380ms (7b); throughput: 60 tok/s int8 on T4-like test harness, int4 throughput +18% but quality hit on long responses. cost rough: int8 ~1.35x per-token vs 7b; int4 ~0.9x but accuracy drop.

jordan: thanks — sounds like int8 is a candidate only for latency-tolerant routes? how did chat vs longform compare?

maria: chat (<=3 turns) parity looks fine int8. longform (>512 tokens) shows degradation: more hallucinations and lower factuality proxy. we also saw tail latency spikes at ~1% for int8 due to kv cache alignment; investigating.

sam: from product POV: high-level ask — can we recommend a routing rule for GTN (docs search, summarization, chat)? goal is save cost without breaking quality for docs-summarize and search rerank.

lee: prelim routing idea: keep default on 7b for longform summarization; route short chat and Q&A to nova-lite-13b-int8 when cost pressure. fallback to 7b on qual signal. pseudo-config below: \n```json
{\n  "route": "by_length_and_feature",\n  "rules": [\n    {"max_tokens": 256, "model": "nova-lite-13b-int8"},\n    {"min_tokens": 257, "model": "7b-fidelity"}\n  ],\n  "fallback_on_quality_drop": true\n}\n```\n
maria: +1. also propose an automated smoke-check: run 50 GTN queries through candidate daily, measure pass rate on our 5 sanity checks; if pass_rate < 95% revert traffic. eval-bot can run this.

eval-bot: scheduled job created: `nova-lite-13b-int8-gtn-smoke` daily 03:00 UTC. will post results to #eng-ml-smoke.

alex: for rollout: suggest canary at 5% traffic for 48h, monitor: token_econ_delta, pass_rate, and p95 latency tail. if token_econ_delta > 20% savings and pass_rate >= 95% we can widen. otherwise rollback.

sam: product acceptance criteria: >15% cost-per-invocation reduction for GTN with no user-visible regressions and <1% increase in user-facing errors. if there is any subjective drift flagged by GTN, hold.

jordan: question on quantization ops: did we try mixed-precision (kv cache int8 + compute int16) as middle ground? that might keep longform quality nearer baseline.

maria: quick test: mixed-precision reduced hallucination gap by ~2 pts vs straight int4, cost sits between int8 and int4. needs infra changes + canary kernel rollout.

lee: infra note: mixed-precision requires new runtime flag and extra regression tests. timeline ~2 weeks if we prioritize.

sam: roadmap: can we do two parallel experiments — (A) int8 canary for chat routes now, (B) mixed-precision perf/quality test next sprint for longform? want ops + ML signoff before GTN rollouts.

maria: yep. action items: \n- maria: run 48h 5% canary on short-chat (start Monday)\n- alex: setup observability dashboards (token_econ_delta, pass_rate, p95 tail) by EOD Fri\n- eval-bot: daily smoke runs & post results\n- lee: estim timeline for mixed-precision infra (2w)\n
alex: logging note: include request-level `quality_checks` array to signal why fallback happened (e.g. "failing_sanity_3"). helps product triage.

sam: thanks — this is actionable. once canary results are in, we'll do a GTN review with product and decide traffic split. :thumbsup:

jordan: one more: add a small human-eval slice (20 samples) for longform after canary expansion to catch subjective regressions early.

maria: agreed. will include that in the handoff doc and the scorecard template. upload to the GTN folder after canary.

lee: FYI deploy-bot: will tag rollout window when canary starts.

maria: ok launching prep. will ping when canary is up.
